quest.5130111FDCC2B0DC.quest_desc: Create a Tome of Superior Scrapping by infusion-enchanting a regular Tome of Scrapping. The recipe needs at least 45 Eterna and 35 Arcana, with Quanta between 25 and 50.

In an anvil, this tome transfers every enchantment but destroys the equipment. Its upgrade guarantees complete enchantment recovery; preserving the item itself requires the next step, a Tome of Extraction.
quest.5130111FDCC2B0DC.title: Obtain 1 × Tome of Superior Scrapping

quest.5130113431CBCC5B.title: Obtain 1 × Gem-Fused Slate
quest.5130113C950B4B1B.quest_desc: Create a Tome of Extraction by infusion-enchanting a Tome of Superior Scrapping. Configure the table for at least 60 Eterna and 45 Arcana, with Quanta between 25 and 75; excessively high Quanta also fails the recipe.
Combining it with enchanted equipment in an anvil transfers all enchantments while preserving the item itself. Use it to rebuild the enchantments of valuable gear without losing the equipment.
quest.5130113C950B4B1B.title: Obtain 1 × Tome of Extraction
quest.51301141D70F43A0.quest_desc: Combine socketed equipment with a Sigil of Withdrawal in a Smithing Table. The operation removes every socketed gem and returns both the gems and the equipment.
Prepare a sigil before moving valuable gems into a new loadout. After extraction, choose their new sockets according to compatibility and the bonuses they provide for that equipment.
quest.51301141D70F43A0.title: Obtain 1 × Sigil of Withdrawal
quest.513011575F40F062.quest_desc: The Enchantment Library accepts enchanted books and stores their enchantments as points. Use those points to create output books or add enchantments to a book in the output slot.

For each enchantment, the library remembers the highest level you have inserted. Many level-I books build up points, but do not unlock higher-level extraction until you deposit an example of that higher level.
Check the library’s capacity before bulk insertion, as excess enchantments can be lost. Its SOQM recipe also requires an Arcane Conduit, a Control Assembly and Infused Shelves.
quest.513011575F40F062.title: Obtain 1 × Enchantment Library
quest.513011587F62519C.quest_desc: A Sigil of Socketing adds one socket to a compatible item. Prepare a gem for the new socket separately and check its bonus for your specific equipment type.

In SOQM, one craft produces three sigils and consumes a Quantum Processor, a Dimensional Matrix, three Gem-Fused Slates, two Gem Dust, Gunpowder and an Amethyst Shard. Plan which equipment will use the resulting batch.
quest.513011587F62519C.title: Obtain 1 × Sigil of Socketing
quest.5130115B35EE7BCB.quest_desc: Obtain Luminous Crystal Shards by salvaging Rare equipment. These are Apotheosis rarity materials; mining quartz or amethyst does not replace this step.
Rare is the highest rarity supported by the Simple Reforging Table. Combine the shards with Sigils of Rebirth and experience to prepare equipment for harder expeditions.
quest.5130115B35EE7BCB.title: Obtain 1 × Luminous Crystal Shard

quest.5130115CF6BAE4BC.title: Obtain 1 × Blazing Hellshelf

quest.51301169EC644453.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Tome of Helmets (apothic_enchanting:helmet_tome). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301169EC644453.title: Obtain 1 × Tome of Helmets
quest.513011758EB23EF2.quest_desc: Sigils of Enhancement fuel the Augmenting Table. Put affix equipment in the upper slot, sigils in the lower slot and select the desired affix from the list.

The table can upgrade or reroll a single affix while preserving the rest. Check the selected action and experience cost before confirming: rerolling replaces that affix rather than simply increasing its numerical bonus.
quest.513011758EB23EF2.title: Obtain 1 × Sigil of Enhancement
quest.51301175D0C8E4CE.quest_desc: Obtain a Godforged Pearl by salvaging Mythic equipment in the Salvaging Table. Compare its affixes with your current loadout first: obtaining the pearl costs the equipment itself.
Reserve two pearls for an Augmenting Table. That station lets you work on individual affixes and complements ordinary equipment reforging.
quest.51301175D0C8E4CE.title: Obtain 1 × Godforged Pearl

quest.5130117D1CEC7C24.title: Obtain 1 × Stoneshelf

quest.51301195B708D449.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Bookshelf
quest.513011A3D94B7550.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Draconic Endshelf (apothic_enchanting:draconic_endshelf). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A3D94B7550.title: Obtain 1 × Draconic Endshelf
quest.513011B18FB3384D.quest_desc: Arcane Sands come from Epic equipment salvaged in the Salvaging Table. Reserve at least two for the full Reforging Table recipe in SOQM.
The material enables Epic reforging, which requires the full table. If your Simple Reforging Table will not accept it, upgrade the station first.
quest.513011B18FB3384D.title: Obtain 1 × Arcane Sands
quest.513011B19833AABF.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Infused Hellshelf (apothic_enchanting:infused_hellshelf). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B19833AABF.title: Obtain 1 × Infused Hellshelf
quest.513011B8817180E8.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Dormant Deepshelf (apothic_enchanting:dormant_deepshelf). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B8817180E8.title: Obtain 1 × Dormant Deepshelf
quest.513011BB818F4911.quest_desc: Combine a Tome of Scrapping with enchanted equipment in an anvil. The equipment is destroyed, and the book receives a randomly selected half of its enchantments, rounded up.
Use it on spare loot. To retain every enchantment, prepare a Tome of Superior Scrapping; to preserve the equipment as well, use a Tome of Extraction.
quest.513011BB818F4911.title: Obtain 1 × Tome of Scrapping
quest.513011C4DCF3129F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Sigil of Unnaming (apotheosis:sigil_of_unnaming). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011C4DCF3129F.title: Obtain 1 × Sigil of Unnaming
quest.513011C5F74E3978.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Tome of Chestplates (apothic_enchanting:chestplate_tome). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011C5F74E3978.title: Obtain 1 × Tome of Chestplates
quest.513011C769D75E3D.quest_desc: Sigils of Rebirth are consumed by both the Simple Reforging Table and the full Reforging Table. Load them into the lower-right slot, with the desired rarity material in the upper-left slot.
Gem Dust alone will not fuel reforging. Dust serves other operations and recipes, while this station requires the finished sigil. Prepare a batch alongside rarity materials and experience.
quest.513011C769D75E3D.title: Obtain 1 × Sigil of Rebirth
quest.513011CCB13A7726.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Tome of the Archers (apothic_enchanting:bow_tome). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011CCB13A7726.title: Obtain 1 × Tome of the Archers

quest.513011DDE81BE33E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Sigil of Supremacy (apotheosis:sigil_of_supremacy). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011DDE81BE33E.title: Obtain 1 × Sigil of Supremacy
quest.513011E1CCD81700.quest_desc: Timeworn Fabric comes from salvaging Uncommon equipment in the Salvaging Table. Read the item’s rarity in its tooltip; armor material or ordinary enchantments alone do not establish that rarity.
Keep the fabric for Uncommon reforging and gem upgrades that require this material tier. Use spare equipment for salvage so you can retain the gear you still rely on.
quest.513011E1CCD81700.title: Obtain 1 × Timeworn Fabric
quest.513011E4C1593023.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Glowing Hellshelf (apothic_enchanting:glowing_hellshelf). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011E4C1593023.title: Obtain 1 × Glowing Hellshelf
quest.513011F4018BF0E3.quest_desc: Obtain Mysterious Scrap Metal by salvaging Common equipment in the Salvaging Table. It is the first rarity material in the spare-loot-to-reforging loop: place it in the Simple Reforging Table’s material slot and add Sigils of Rebirth.
quest.513011F4018BF0E3.title: Obtain 1 × Mysterious Scrap Metal
quest.513011F4DA8543FE.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Tome of the Miners (apothic_enchanting:pickaxe_tome). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011F4DA8543FE.title: Obtain 1 × Tome of the Miners

quest.513011F75AC66274.title: Obtain 1 × Crystalline Seashelf
quest.514D11053C24F796.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement World Tier: Ascent (apotheosis:progression/ascent). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11053C24F796.title: World Tier: Ascent
quest.514D11268DEDBF9A.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement World Tier: Frontier (apotheosis:progression/frontier). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11268DEDBF9A.title: World Tier: Frontier
quest.514D11362B44E731.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement World Tier: Summit (apotheosis:progression/summit). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11362B44E731.title: World Tier: Summit
quest.514D114DC1B13CA4.quest_desc: Obtain your first Gem Dust by dropping an unwanted Apotheosis gem into the world and letting an Anvil block fall onto it. Once you have a Salvaging Table, use it to break down spare gems. This quest requires four Gem Dust as well as the Gem Cutting Table.

Gem cutting raises a gem’s purity. Upgrades usually require Gem Dust, a rarity material and a second gem of the same purity. Before spending materials, read the bonus for your intended equipment type: one gem can provide different effects in different items.
quest.514D114DC1B13CA4.title: Obtain 1 × Gem Cutting Table + Obtain 4 × Gem Dust
quest.514D11521F7911EE.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Enchanting Table (minecraft:enchanting_table). The items are not consumed by this task.
Earn the native advancement The Basics (apothic_enchanting:30ench). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11521F7911EE.title: Obtain 1 × Enchanting Table + The Basics
quest.514D11649778EA6D.quest_desc: Start with a salvage loop: break down unwanted affix equipment in the Salvaging Table to obtain its rarity material. Inspect the item’s properties first, because salvaging consumes it.

In the Simple Reforging Table, place equipment in the center, the desired rarity material in the upper-left slot and Sigils of Rebirth in the lower-right slot. You also need experience levels. This table supports rarities up to and including Rare.
Reforging can add affixes to valid ordinary equipment or replace an existing affix set. Compare the three offered outcomes: the more expensive choice does not guarantee a better set for your build.
quest.514D11649778EA6D.title: Obtain 1 × Salvaging Table + Obtain 1 × Simple Reforging Table
quest.514D11784324BCC0.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement World Tier: Haven (apotheosis:progression/haven). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11784324BCC0.title: World Tier: Haven

quest.514D118B985ECC64.title: Obtain 1 × Augmenting Table
quest.514D11D2CD85AD9D.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement Draconic Enchanting (apothic_enchanting:100ench). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11D2CD85AD9D.title: Draconic Enchanting
quest.514D11E79566207A.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement Mastering Hell and Sea (apothic_enchanting:60ench). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11E79566207A.title: Mastering Hell and Sea
quest.514D11E8DD1AE2CE.quest_desc: The full Reforging Table unlocks Epic and higher-rarity reforging. Its SOQM recipe consumes the Simple Reforging Table and requires Arcane Sands, Netherite, Refined Obsidian, an Arcane Conduit and a Control Assembly; prepare the components before dismantling your old station.

Like the simple table, it needs a rarity material, Sigils of Rebirth and experience to operate. Reforging generates a new affix set. To change one affix while keeping the others, progress to the Augmenting Table.
quest.514D11E8DD1AE2CE.title: Obtain 1 × Reforging Table
quest.514D11ECA99D525F.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement World Tier: Pinnacle (apotheosis:progression/pinnacle). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.514D11ECA99D525F.title: World Tier: Pinnacle
